dataformat.name: groovyJson
dataformat.title: Groovy JSon
dataformat.description: Transform between JSon and java.util.Map or java.util.List objects
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,json

marshalIn.description: A Map, a Groovy Node or a Jackson JsonNode to write as JSON. Text, bytes, a stream or a file is written as it is; a List is not supported

marshalOut.description: The JSON in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalOut.description: A Map (Groovy LazyMap) for a JSON object, a List (ArrayList) for an array

prettyPrint.description: Whether to pretty print output nicely formatted.
